## Change type

- [ ] Evidence correction
- [ ] Editorial / translation
- [ ] Proposal change
- [ ] Infrastructure

## Evidence boundary

Describe which statements are source-backed facts, boundaries, or project recommendations.

## Bilingual parity

- [ ] EN and LV public pages remain structurally aligned, or the reason is documented.

## Validation

- [ ] `make check`
- [ ] `git diff --check`
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, or live exploitation detail added.
